$comment: Anchor manifest for the bundled Markdown Editor addin. Mirrors lsp-server-sync/lsp-snapshot.json in intent: this file records exactly which upstream release we redistribute, so 'what shipped' is inspectable rather than a hand-maintained mystery. Unlike the LSP there is NO build step -- upstream publishes a prebuilt release zip, so the sync downloads, verifies and extracts it. Consumed by Sync-MarkdownEditor.ps1. See markdown-editor-sync/README.md.

attribution.note: MIT requires the copyright and permission notice to travel with every redistributed copy. The upstream release ZIP does NOT contain the LICENSE file, so Sync-MarkdownEditor.ps1 fetches it from the repo at the pinned tag and stages it beside the payload as LICENSE-ClarionMarkdownEditor.txt. Do not drop that file from the installer's [Files] list.
attribution.history: The addin began as ClarionLive's own ClarionMarkdownEditor and was forked and substantially developed by msarson. We now redistribute the fork rather than our original; upstream is the maintained line and the place user reports belong.

identityVersionIsAuthoritative.note: TRAP: the upstream DLL's FileVersion resource is NOT bumped between releases -- v1.2.0 still reports 1.0.2.0, identical to v1.0.2. Inno Setup's default 'is the existing file newer?' comparison is therefore INERT for this addin and cannot tell one release from another. Freshness must come from the <Identity version="..."/> attribute in ClarionMarkdownEditor.addin, which upstream does maintain, and which is what resolvedIdentityVersion below records for the installer's only-if-newer check.

targetPin.note: Tag to sync toward; -Tag overrides. AUTO-UPDATED to the last successfully synced tag by Sync-MarkdownEditor.ps1 -- edit by hand only to stage a pin to a NEWER release before running the sync.

currentPin.note: AUTO-UPDATED by Sync-MarkdownEditor.ps1 on each successful sync -- the observed state of the just-synced payload.
